description:
Who We Are 

 Founded in 1980 as Aardvark Financial, TransMarket Group (TMG) is a privately held global markets proprietary trading firm in Chicago. We use next-generation technology to capture opportunities around the world and manage risk in financial markets. Our mission is to bless others through the services we provide and through the generous stewardship of the wealth we create. 

 TMG is a well-established and profitable business as a respected member of the global financial system for over 40 years, but also is like a startup because the potential of our group is at least one order of magnitude greater than what we are currently producing. We have an entrepreneurial culture and collaboratively develop our business with patience and discipline; we work hard, learn constantly, and relentlessly improve our expertise. 

 Description 

 Our Data Engineering team designs, builds, and supports the data systems that power our proprietary trading business. This smaller, focused team works closely with software developers, traders, operations, and accounting/finance teams to make high-quality data accessible, reliable, and actionable across the firm. You will help develop production-quality pipelines, services, databases, and tools that support trading operations, reporting, research, and automation. The role offers a high degree of ownership and hands-on learning, with exposure to Python, SQL, Linux, APIs, data modeling, and financial systems. The components you work on will help ensure that critical business and trading data is accurate, timely, and dependable.

 Responsibilities 

 
 Work with senior developers to assist in and learn all facets of data engineering and development applied to the business

 Develop, code, maintain, and support production-quality components for global proprietary trading

 Develop expertise in data engineering principles, Python, SQL, and high-performance finance systems

 Collaborate with technology, software, trading, business, and accounting/finance teams

 
 Requirements 

 
 BA/BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience

 Strong Python skills

 Proficiency with SQL and relational database design

 Comfort working in a Linux environment

 Source control with Git

 Knowledge of RESTful API design

 Docker/containerization

 This position requires physical presence and is on-site (no remote work)

 
 Good to have
 

 
 C++

 Workflow orchestration (Airflow)

 Experience integrating LLMs or AI tooling into engineering workflows

 Exposure to financial markets, trading operations, or clearing

 Dashboard design and data visualization

 Benefits 

 We offer one of the most generous profit sharing programs in the industry because we believe our employees should be able to take part in our rapid growth and success. We are proud to offer more world-class benefits for our full-time employees and their families. 

 TransMarket Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status.
